About the fund

Education opens doors.

Founded in 1969 in memory of George Richmond, Douglas Phillips, Cecilia Sinnett, Denver Leggo and Shaun Suddard.

The Memorial Trust Fund supports graduates of Gaspé Polyvalent's English Section as they pursue post-secondary education and vocational training. By helping students access programs that are not available in Gaspé, the fund aims to ease some of the costs of continuing their studies and preparing for a career.

01

Support further learning

Provide financial assistance to eligible graduates enrolled in recognized post-secondary studies.

02

Make new paths possible

Help students pursue programs and training that are not offered in the Gaspé area.

03

Invest in future goals

Encourage graduates as they build the knowledge and skills for their chosen careers.

Honouring their memory since 1969

The fund was founded in 1969 in memory of five individuals. Their names remain at the heart of its commitment to supporting local graduates.

George RichmondDouglas PhillipsCecilia SinnettDenver LeggoShaun Suddard

Who may apply

Eligibility requirements

Applicants must meet all of the following requirements:

  • Be a graduate of Gaspé Polyvalent's English Section.
  • Have been accepted by a recognized post-secondary institution.
  • Be pursuing a program of study that is not offered in Gaspé.
  • Submit a copy of the registration payment receipt from the post-secondary institution.
  • Have not previously received financial assistance from this Memorial Trust Fund. Previous recipients are not eligible for renewal or a second award.
October 1 – November 15Applications are accepted annually during this period. Your application and registration payment receipt must be received no later than November 15.
Application process

How to apply

Prepare your application and include a copy of your registration payment receipt from the post-secondary institution. Submit both between October 1 and November 15.

1. Complete the application

Fill in your contact information, graduation year, institution and program details.

2. Attach your receipt

Include a copy of the receipt showing payment of your registration at the institution.

3. Submit by November 15

Email or mail your completed application and supporting document using the contact information below.

Please note: Previous recipients are not eligible to apply again. Submission of an application does not guarantee an award.

Frequently asked questions

Questions & answers

Who is eligible to apply?

Graduates of Gaspé Polyvalent’s English Section who have been accepted at a recognized post-secondary institution for a program not offered in Gaspé, have a registration payment receipt, and have not previously received assistance from this fund.

When can I apply?

Applications are accepted each year from October 1 through November 15. Your application and receipt must be received by November 15.

Can I receive assistance more than once?

No. Previous recipients cannot renew or receive a second award.

What documents should I include?

A completed application form and a copy of your post-secondary institution registration payment receipt.

How do I send my application?

Email your application and receipt to ronaldmundle@gmail.com, or mail them to the address in the Contact section.

Does applying guarantee financial assistance?

No. Submitting an application does not guarantee an award.

What if I have another question?

Use the email address in the Contact section to ask the fund directly.
